The '''communications center''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]] was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] base during the [[Jedi Civil War]], that was [[Mission on Iridonia|attacked]] by a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] under orders from [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] agent, [[Acaadi]]. The attack was used as preparation for a surprise attack from a Sith [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].
